review_description: Kunal and team provided various options that meet my requirements. His quotes were the best from the options provided by solar quotes. He was available whenever i had queries and even supported my council application due to being in a heritage conservation area. Installation was great. Would definitely recommend!

I was happy with the customer service, communication and punctuality with this company recommended by Solar Quotes. However, the installation was a bit amateur as they drilled 3 holes in the wrong spot on my load bearing wall and then patched it up with silicon & a similar paint that doesn't match my wall when I specifically requested for it to be a hebel patch (never rectified properly). They also scraped off some black paint from my gutters & pipes with their metal ladders and left some panels in a slightly wonky state, they also used timber screws on my hebel wall installed at lazy angles which cracked the facade of my wall a bit (they came back an fixed these in a timely manner). About 1.5-2 years into the install, two of the solar panels have come loose and started squeaking up and down on the roof with wind, I've rectified this myself. However, the main thing is that there was no leakage on the roof and that all the electrical wiring & equipment is still intact and working well. The owner did say that they wouldn't use these installers again so hopefully the quality of their install is better now.
Excellent value for money. Knowledgeable owner (who did the quote and answered all my questions). Installer very professional who took pride in installation. Highly recommeded

Prompt and professional responses from Head office and Installer.Nitin and crew did a great job of installation and happy to answer all questions and requests during the job. He took pride in his work and I would happily use him again.Prompt follow up after installation on grid connection.Very good experience with Sparklife on quality of work and product.

We went with the recommendation from SolarQuotes and by the time our supplier made contact we felt armed and ready with the right information to ensure we weren't getting ripped off. Sparklife Solar gave us a range of options with lots of information about the returns, the efficiency of the unit and what system best suited our specific location. The install was slightly protracted because of an unsafe amount of dust on our roof but the problem was soon rectified and it didn't affect the eventual cost. Kunal from Sparklife Solar was very responsive and helpful and the installers were efficient and not at all invasive.

We are happy with the price, suggestions, installation, followup, and the system as a whole. We found Sparklife Solar professional and reliable. It is solar system that we are satisfied with that we help our parents to instal theirs. Highly recommended.

There were a couple of problems with two of the original quoters as they thought the roof was too steep. But Sparklife had no problem with it. They were delayed a couple of days due to high winds but did a great job in good time. Friendly and competent. Organised the grid connection, cleared up when finished and we couldn’t have been happier. Can’t give them less than 5 stars for all aspects of the installation.Strongly recommended.

The initial sales and quoting process was good.    A representative came to the property and we had a very informative discussion about suitable systems.      The installation took place in an efficient and timely way.       Sparklife arranged with our energy retailer for the replacement of our old electricity meter with a smart meter.   That, too, took place at an agreed time and was also neat and efficient.     Now it is all up and running, it is performing as expected, with both local monitoring and retailer monitoring.     Altogether, we are very pleased with it.

The quotation process was very professional with a full quotation including panels and inverter on the spot.A follow up after another quote received was satisfactorily responded to.Installer arrived when promised and was able to solve a problem with my roof. Installation was finalised after roof problem was rectified by the installer.Very happy with the full process.

Sparklife Solar have been a good company to deal with. They have been fast to respond to queries and helpful when I have had any issues.The installation happened on the day scheduled, the guys turned up, installed as quoted and were happy to answer my questions etc. They possibly could have tidied up a bit more after the job, but overall not a big deal.The grid connection took a few weeks, which was a bit of a pain, but that was due to the poor service speen of AusGrid, not sparklife.It's been installed for over two years now and I have had one or two issues, but each of these have been replaced promptly and the support I have receivd from Sparklife has been really good. They answer my emails and help out.I do recommend them as an installer.
sales process was simple and efficient, install was completed on-time without any issues. I was connected the next business day after installation which was all taken care of for me.

My experience of installing solar was fantastic with Sparklife Solar.I dealt with Kunal who was extremely helpful and flexible as it took a while for me to realise what i really wanted, and with Sparklife i believe i got just that and at a price point i was happy with.My layout ended up being slightly different that i originally wanted but this was sorted out with Kunal's help.With all the various Solar companies out there offering so many different brands i would highly recommend Sparklife Solar.

The install has been very smooth from start to finish. The only item pending now, is waiting for the smart meter install that is scheduled next week. Andy from Sale is very knowledgeable and friendly to talk to. During the install, there was an issue for my roof that was not able to fit all panels that were quoted originally, but Mark the installer, is able to work around by moving those panels to another side of the house. Power production is still optimal. Sparkline just makes solar system install like a piece of cake and handles profeessionally, including the admin team actioned on emails very swiftly. I am also given the soft copy of user manual, warranty information that is very well organized. Thank you.

Yes, we are happy with all the above questions so far.We cannot compare with other companies, as we are very new customer to install solar.But one thing that I would like the sales do , is to provide information about the choice of installing  mesh guards to go around the panels, the purpose is to prevent birds build nests under the panels.We did not know this concern until a friend shared her experience that birds build nest under her solar panels.Had I know this possibility I would be getting the mesh guards done during the installation.

We were looking for a solar system that is affordable, sensible, fits the design of our house, and meets our electricity needs which is installed professionally and backed by reliable after-sale service. We went through the process of selection, and we decided on Sparklife Solar. Andy was very knowledgeable and professional. He provided us not just with a quote, but options. He explained the pros and cons of each option and helped us to choose the best one for our situation. The installers were efficient, punctual, careful, and professional too. It gave us a sense of reassurance of working with someone who has been in the business for a long time. Confidence is essential for us as the system is meant to last for more than 10 years. We did have a small issue after installation, and it was promptly ratified satisfactorily without any delay. A good after-sale customer service is also important to us as the system should work for us for a decade or more. We would recommend Sparklife as we are very satisfied with what it can offer.

Sparklife Solar were very professional with the removal of old 3kw solar system and the installation of a new 13kw system all in 1 day!The team were punctual, tidy and professional at all times.Andy (sales) was our first contact with Sparklife Solar and the reason we chose to go with Sparklife Solar (after having other quotes from other Solar companies). Both Kunal and Shogun were also really helpful in answering any queries we had.Connection went smoothly (as we were replacing and old system ) and thanks to Shagun ensuring the necessary paperwork was provided to our energy company.We would have no hesitation whatsoever in recommending Sparklife Solar.

The quoting process was seamless.  One installer insisted on a site visit - the other 2, Sparklife Solar being one of them, quoted without a site visit.Kunal, the owner, was happy to answer all the questions I had.  And he would turn around quotes incorporating changes incredibly quickly.The installation date was actually pushed forward to accommodate heat wave conditions expected later in the week - suited me to sort out the installation earlier!The installers were friendly, polite and very knowledgeable.  They took the time to explain what was going to happen and what they needed from me through the install process.  It took about 4 hours all up and they left the site clean and tidy.The admin team at Sparklife sent in all the forms to the power company to start the process of upgrading the meter.So far, all is working well and looking forward to reduced bills !!

The quoting process was done on the day (about an hour) with a friendly salesperson and the system was installed within 2 weeks as promised.The installers were friendly and efficient and were gone by lunchtime.They arranged for the Smartmeter to be replaced and came back to adjust the inverter software so that my app worked. They have always been responsive and helpful.The quote was lower than for a competitors comparable system.
All went smoothly. questions answered promptly. installers were good. the company did what they stated they would in a no fuss professional manner.

Truly, a painless experience. Kunal & Andy made it very easy and quick to make the switch to solar. We're saving so much on power and with all this good weather, we're raking in the savings! We paid the deposit, and they started working that week!!! We went with the go big approach and I'm glad we did. Team was very clear on what was being done and why and was able to allay any and all concerns we had. I almost can't wait to upgrade to a bigger system/battery bank. I will be calling them back for sure!

Sparklife Solar have been amazing to deal with. All queries with regards to the system configuration and requirements were dealt with utmost knowledge and recommendations. The installers were very punctual and professional. All necessary paperwork was provided in a timely manner and also helped organise the grid connection after the install. If you are looking for high quality workmanship and Solar equipment   Sparklife Solar are the ones to get in touch.

The whole process from the initial phone call to installation and switching over live to solar has been amazingly seamless. All of the team have been really helpful in answering questions and making me feel at ease with my decision to go with Sparklife Solar. The team that arrived to fit the solar panels and system worked so well as a team, something I have rarely experienced as a customer. I can't rate the staff and products of Sparklife Solar highly enough. You are amazing.

Quoting was efficient and prompt. The price was quite reasonable for the quality of the equipment. Kunal was very helpful at this stage.The installation went well. There was a delay of three or four days before it could be finalised because of high winds but I didn’t consider that to be a problem. We have a relatively steep roof and safety was paramount. Incidentally, because of the steepness of the roof Kunal had earlier recommended a site visit by the installer to check the viability of the installation. He said it was somewhat more difficult than usual but it was still OK to proceed. There was also a small reduction in the number of panels following the site visit due to the configuration of the roof. That was no problem. If anyone is thinking of an installation I would strongly recommend that those quoting actually visit the site.Oscar and his buddy completed the work on the rearranged date quickly and efficiently and spent some time explaining the app that came with the system.If someone suggested that they were thinking of getting solar installed I would definitely recommend Sparklife.

I got the product that I wanted with a reasonable quotation.The solar installer broke my ceiling but they fix it.It just makes it very inconvenient.The customer service is good they value the customer.

Andy is awesome!!Right from the start he was friendly, knowledgeable, and passionate about solar power. He explained everything to us and knew what we needed.We will be coming back for future panels and other stuff needed but for now, we are more than happy and totally recommend Sparklife Solar.

Very pleased with the solar installation completed by Sparklife  Solar.Great communication from Kunal right from the start, without the high-pressure sales pitch.The installation exceeded my expectations. Mark and the installation team operated with a very high level of professionalism throughout.I'd have no hesitation recommending the Sparklife Solar team.

My sales consultant was polite, friendly and assisted with any queries I had.It was an easy process and the installation went smoothly.I would highly recommend this company if you are considering solar.

Sparklife solar was great to deal with.  Kunal was friendly and knowledgeable, and came to inspect the property before giving a quote. He offered a couple options at different price points and recommended system size based on my usage and future proof.The installation team were friendly, professional and punctual.Sparklife organised the grid connection and we were up and running on solar with no delays. I have had a few questions after installation and Kunal has responded quickly and with the same good customer service as during the quote process.

Sparklife solar were fantastic to work with!. Andy was polite and helpful with making a suitable and prompt appointment time. At the appointment he was very thorough & explained all the details to us. He then followed up promptly with a very fast installation date. The team that installed the system were professional, polite, tidy & efficient. We had a small problem during the installation and the customer service we received and problem solving they showed was exceptional. We are fully up and running with our new solar system and we love it. Highly recommend the Sparklife Solar team!
Overall very proactive and honest approach to quote and installation. Agent visited site for quote.Installers did a great job. Professional and great attention to detail.
Too early to say, but service was good and the installation went well, except for the unavoidable weather delays.
Friendly, professional and efficient service. Sales staff and technicians were knowledgeable and easy to deal with. Thank you

3 Solar Panels, after 3 - 4 weeks since installation seemed to have moved or become loose and were no longer sitting flush on the mounting rails.Sparklife answered all my emails and came onsite to investigate and rectified the issue.Professional attitude, unlike other companies who ignore you once your money has been taken.

I chose Sparklife to install our system because they provided comprehensive and competitive quotes. They were very responsive to my many questions about the products. The install was seamless and there has been excellent after sales service to check in on how the system was performing. I recommend Akhil and his team to anyone trying to make sense of all the solar options available.

Efficient sales process with people who weren't pushy but fast and knowledgeable.The system is producing more than we expected in winter, our installation date was on one of the darkest days of the year in June and we have been seeing days where we max out our inverter capacity, and it generates a fair bit from early morning until late afternoon. We only expect this to get better. They weren't sure if they would be able to install as many panels as they did, but were happy to give us a quote based on what we wanted and promised to reduce the price of any panels not possible to install, but we got as many as we hoped based on their site inspection.Installation was booked faster and sooner than we expected and they even came a day earlier than they booked in for in the end (after checking that that was okay). The installation was all done in a day, or less than really. They adapted really nicely to our property and the specific needs it had. Some of the DC cables could have been done slightly neater, not better, and I wasn't 100% happy with the connection to the main board but it wasn't enough to complain, just maybe check that you're happy with things.We already had a smart meter so once we sent the paperwork to our energy retailer that was all that was needed, they took a while to get us all set up but because the connections were all done right by Sparklife on the day we got all the feed-in credits starting on the day of installation! (I imagine if you don't already have a smartmeter that is prepared for solar this isn't going to be THAT smooth but Sparklife certainly helped make us feel confident in this working the best it could possibly have)They were very nice to deal with regarding the payment, we kept getting payment reminders after we had paid but they sorted that out when we pointed it out, I imagine that would have been very helpful if we hadn't paid when we did. The deposit was very standard at 10% and could be paid quickly by card to ensure we got the installation booked quickly, but they had other options too.
Very happy with everything so far. Fantastic customer service. Sparklife organised smart meter etc and all seems good.

Amazing service and excellent communication. Right from the start, the quotation process was outstanding compared to other highly rated installers. I was impressed by the level of detail provided. The day of the installation was scheduled promptly. Not issues whatsoever. I highly recommend Sparklife Solar and would choose them again in the future if I need to..Kunal and Akhil was really helpful and knowledgeable.Definitely Would recommend themKS

Kunal from Sparklife Solar was great at helping me understand my options and needs. He made sure to ask what my budget was and usage situation. I had previous sales people who didn't even ask me these simple questions and provided a quote anyway.Kunal helped me understand my shading situation and based on that suggested that I go with a micro inverter system. Although it was slightly above my budget I went ahead with it to optimise what I could get with Solar.Installation process was very smooth and clear lines of communications at all times before and after.I needed help rearranging the layout of the solar array in the enphase app and Akhil from Sparklife was very prompt and helpful.

I was given options in terms of solar panels and inverters as well as the sales person's honest opinion of all of these.  The quote included all the correct/recommended components; (Solarquotes recommends a 3 phase inverter for a 3 phase power system such as mine).  The inverter was sized correctly to the system.  The sales person came to my site and was knowledgeable and gave honest advice that helped me decide on the size of the system and other aspects.The installation was very smooth.  They completed it in two separate occasions, pausing work when conditions became unsafe.  The lead installer listened to my request for corrosion resistant fixings for the conduit and came up with a neat solution we were both happy with.Grid connection was all organised well. A few days after the installation I noticed I had some trouble getting historical data from the Inverter app.  I contacted Sparklife and they worked with the Inverter company to give me a solution.The whole process was smooth and I have no complaints.  I am now the happy owner of a durable solar installation.

Installation was very good. Lack of information with regard to what was going to happen once panels installed.  Unable to complete on day as not informed we needed a wifi extender nor did we have a smart metre which I had to arrange. Eventually everything sorted and system working well.
Great process, thanks to all involved. Installation went very smoothly.

Sparklife were prompt with their communication, both durinq quoting, planning the installation, and after install.They installed when they said they would, arrived when they said they would, did the job and cleaned up after themselves.I can't fault the team, and couldn't ask for more.

The guys that did the installation were efficient, hard working and polite.They did an amazing job and cleaned up at the end of the day.Having had to postpone due to rain the first attempt, it was very pleasing to see them turn up on an overcast day with the "Let's see how much we can get done today". All finished by 3.30pm.

Sales quoting was easy and Sales person kept the process easy for me to understand as i am new to the process.Installation started a bit later than was originally quoted due to my roof being glazed ceramic (slippery due to wet conditions) and Sydney region had a lot of rain in December 2021. But when the installation team began installing in January 2022, they were extremely polite, tidy and always punctual. The installers came on 13 Jan to install the racking system. They are scheduled to come on 18 Jan to install the panels and do the wiring (if does not rain).Customer service to this point is very good. Sparklife continued to keep me informed of events. I will need to wait and see how they will coordinate the grid connection after the installation, as its too early to tell.

I dealt with Akhil during the sales process, he was able to answer all my questions and was very helpful in explaining all the many options available to me.I didn't feel pressured into "upgrading", and thought I was getting advice on the most appropriate system for me.The team of installers arrived on time, got straight to it, did a great job and left no mess. The guy that had the job of bringing the inverter online with the app, had a few tech issues, but stayed until all was resolved and working fine.The after sales experience has been great too. I had a few follow up questions which were all dealt with in a great way.I would highly recommend Akhil and the Sparklife team.

Thanks to the team at Sparklife. We installed 6.6kW of panels with a 5kW inverter. Of all the quotes I got, Sparklife took the most time to get my requirements and come up with the options so I felt most comfortable taking this quote.I was surprised they went with a flat layout on my 4 degree roof, but this works really well. During Oct / Nov the two months we‘ve had it we see between 10 and 40kWh and on a clear day we see more than 2kWh from 8am to nearly 5pm so this decision seems vindicated. Layout and ducting, as well as inverter positioning are not intrusive on the house, and you’d barely know its there.I got advice on what I needed to do to prepare for the system and after installation about what was happening. Sparklife assisted in changing my energy plan and I later changed it again after the gas was disconnected. Simple calculations would have pre solar gas and electricity daily charge of approx $5 and post solar electricty only would now weve seen between -$0.30 to $1.50 per day.

Just have my solar install  last few weeks.Highly  recommend for sparklife Solar solar.Look for Kunal and sunny was great guy.Kunal was honest and help you understand  the system.Great  price  Great  service,5*

I managed to isolate & progress a very competitive quote that permitted design of a customised solution to Solar network, at an affordable price.Sparklife were efficient, on-time, nothing was too much trouble, highly recommended & they arranged swap-over.A pleasant experience.

I sought a quote based on the reviewsThe sales quoting process was clear and concise.They were very patient and answered all my questions and were not pushy. I took weeks to decide on a vendorI have Swiss terracotta tiles. Some vendors refused to quote for swiss tiles.Ritika from Sparklife found me a subcontractor (poweredup)that was comfortable with the Swiss tile.They came and inspected the site and confirmed they could install with no leaks etc.Installation went smoothly. They have a great team that is very efficient.They installed 10kw and 36 panels in less than a day (they commented that if it wasn't for the swiss tiles they could have done it in half a day)One team looks after the roof install and one focuses on the inverter and the powerboard.They had to grind down part of every tile where the bracket was so that the tiles sat flush.The panel layout they chose maximised my north facing panels and they cleaned up after themselves and blew down the roof and gutters..They were unable to commision my Solar Analytics on the day but returned the next weekday.Customer service was great. After installation i realised they strung my north array with 2 long strings instead of 2 blocks. This resulted in morning and afternoon shading bringing down the production.I explained the issue to Ritika at Sparklife and she had the installers out a couple of days later.They restrung it into desired configuration for no charge and no attitude.Sparklife quickly andpainlesley filed the paperwork and organised the smart meter install.I would highly recommend Sparklife

The quoting process was smooth, I requested multiple quotes for different panels and inverters as I found more information. Akhil gave me a recommended one and I agreed with his recommendation.The installation process was punctual and smooth, they indicated when we can expect the electricity to be turned off and how long.The connection to smart meter and warranty were very promptly (the following day after installation day). Due to covid19 lockdown, there was a slight delay of smart meter connection. But that was the case with non essential activities.Now we are live with solar systems. So far they are as expected and more. Thank you. I recommend Sparklife for to install your solar system.

Very happy with my solar installation. Sales team were really helpful and prompt and flexible. Great service and high worksmanship on the job. Coupled with prompt and professional after care, i would gladly refer this company. Thanks to the team at Sparklife solar and solarquotes for getting me in touch.

The personal sales process from initial site visit, explanation of options, to the different pricing options was what convinced me to go with this company.The installation was completed in 1 day as they had 'spare' labour on the day of the installation.Customer service was great.  The guys were all respectful of the property and worked to conceal the cabling which was important for me.They explained the grid connection process and have assured me that the connection, with a new smart meter, should be seamless once Sparklife provide the paperwork to the Energy Retailer, which should take 2-3 weeks

I found that the services of Sparklife were good and professional.  I strongly recommend that at least 3 quotes should be sought for cost and services comparison.  Solarquotes provided very useful information that helped me orgainsed acquisition of the quotes.

Akhil from Sparklife was fantastic. He kept me in the loop from start to finish and replied to my emails and questions without delay. Sparklife we’re the only company who sent a representative to our property to assess the site and recommend the size of system. Installation was quick and efficient, no damage to roof tiles at all and the team were polite and explained everything in detail. The aftersales team so far have been absolutely great, again giving me advice and helping install monitoring apps on my phone. They have chased up my electrical supplier to change my meter to a smart meter so I’ve had no issues whatsoever. Thoroughly recommend the Sparklife team. Excited to see how the system performs.

The whole process from quoting to installation was was a great experience with Sparklife. The Sparklife team were very accommodating and they also assisted with the Grid connection.The solar system that was installed was within my budget and couldn’t be matched by any other supplier. It speaks volumes and was surprised with the quotes received by the other companies.My only advice to Sparklife is just to be more tidy once they finish. I had to clean up some left over cable snips, worried my pet dog would find these.Besides that, everything else went well.
Sale and quoting process was quick and easyInstallation was well coordinated and the work crew very polite and considerate.Customer service after the installation can not be faulted.

Sales process was very smooth from start to finish.Installers arrived on time as committed and finished the install within 2 days.Very good service from Kunal and excellent service from the installation team.I would highly recommend Sparklife Solar to anyone who wants a good quality solar system.
Excellent work by Akhil and the Sparklife team.  Very responsive to calls and email throughout the process and were able to get the install done sooner than originally advised.

From the outset Akhil from Sparklife Solar was informative and offered great advice. He listened to what we where after and remained within our set budget offering a great system. Kept in contact through the whole process from deciding what system we installed, through the installation process and finally the connection to the grid. Sparklife Solar also assisted in setting up our monitoring App on our system and explaining the readings. Overall a pleasure to deal with. Just waiting for our next bill to see our savings.

Sparklife Solar was very good at all stages of the process. They answered all my questions during the quote process. The quote price was very competitive. The installation took a bit longer than expected but that was because of my roof tiles being old and very fragile. The Enphase system that was installed meets my expectations.

Edit: 14/10/2020I have come to know that the installation team member has been removed from their installation team.Original review: 25/9/2020The sales person was kind and willing to help on my queries. Installation service could also have been good if one of their workers wouldn't have some behavioural issues - e.g. ridiculous jokes, lack of preventative actions on COVID-19 and keeping on to demand one of my collectables. Also, they didn't use gutter protector for one of two ladders even though I raised concerns on gutter damage or scratch.

Quote arrived promptly, I wanted some changes to inverter location and wanted an energy meter all which were accomplished with minimum fuss.The installer went about their business in a very professional way, no smoking, swearing or loud music.All rubbish/packaging, broken tiles etc was cleaned up and taken away.Sure a few tiles were broken in the install process but was to be expected on a terracotta tile roof.Customer Service was very good, kept informed of progress and when installers would arrive on site, all documentation required for grid connection was handled by the installer.Did end up with a leak from the roof. Received very prompt service with next business day response where a broken tile was discovered and replaced.All documentation as per Solarquotes website was provided, albeit I had to ask for it. But still not a problem for the installer.

Sales and quoting process was open and honest.Alternatives were provided.Installation was on time and as committed.Post installation application for meter installation to energy provider was made in time and follow up survey requested.

Me along with few of my other friends got our solar panel system installed from Aman from Sparklife Solar. The quote was competitive compared to anyone else but most importantly reliability.With all horror stories we had heard about installation companies that forget you once the system is installed, we found Aman very reliable and approachable when needed, during and post installation.Highly recommended for peace of mind.

Good experience going through process and finally narrowing it down and having system installed. No complaints, all went well. I will comment that Sparklife uses contractors so it may not be same experience for others but I’ve been lucky with the crew that worked on my system, professional, courteous, on time, went above and beyond but they did remark they aren’t planning to do more retail jobs as they generally specialise in commercial work.

I got the Solar Panel setup installed in August 2020 from Aman (sparklife solar). His knowledge in the industry is second to none, and he made sure that I understood and went for the correct system. No hiccups from quoting to installation. He even went an extra mile to ensure that my Inverter was registered for warranty purposes.For anyone looking to go Solar, I would highly recommend Aman Sethi from Sparklife Solar as your SPARKLING SOLAR CONSULTANT!

I got Sparklife Solar to install a solar system through a recommendation and they were amazing from the start guiding me through the details of the system that I will be getting and the process afterwards. Aman was always there to answer any questions I had. Even making things happen whilst he wasn't feeling well. Everything was installed at the said time and went smoothly. In all, I would recommend them to others looking to have solar installed.

Sparklife Solar is an amazing local company which you can rely on. I myself got 7 quotes, and based on the level of knowledge, willingness to help and price, they were the best. Aman in particular was great and professional, finding the best solution for us and being frank with what was happening. I even recommended a friend to get Solar with them, because of the great experience. Good work guys!

The sales process was reasonable as the sales person took us through various options and check shading issues. The quote is adequate but would have liked to see extra details.Installation we were slotted in a week earlier than scheduled which suited us. The team they used did a good job with the panel alignment and looks well done. We did get the wrong inverted which was quick fixed on the day.They followed up with grid connection with our energy provider right after the panels were completed.

Solar installation was quick and precise. Installer is very friendly, listened to me and answered all my queries. Also explained to me all different options I can choose from. Very supportive with all the questions. No push or rush to book, however once book turn around was quite fast. I got installed Solar system within a week and update to energy supplier was also quick. Good job definitely recommended.

The consultant from Sparklife was very helpful and knowledgeable. The installation took place within three days after the deposit was paid.  The installation and grid connection all went through smoothly.

The sales and quotation process was great, Aman@Sparklife kept me well informed and stayed in touch throughout the process. I was very happy with the detailed quote.The installation itself was smooth. The boys turned up exactly when they committed to, the install was as per design and they cleaned up well after they were done. The installers spent some time explaining how the system works which I appreciate.Sparklife organized the grid connection and helped setting up the monitoring app.
Fantastic service and good customer service. Value for money. Good service.

Sparklife provided excellent services during quoting, installation and after the install. They were able to get the installation done within three days after the deposit was paid. The sale consultant (Ritika) is knowledgeable and professional in response to all our questions.
The job was done well and I am very satisfied with the outcomes. Nice seeing the electricity bill drop dramatically

Very fast and efficient quote.  Polite customer service. Installation went smoothly and even suggested different configurations with panels.  I am impressed.  Follow up with connections to supplier was very good.  Great job, Rohit.

I approached Sparklife Solar after seeing reviews on SolarQuotes, while they weren't the cheapest, I went with them as they were on balance for my needs, the best value.  Rohit was up front and helpful with the quoting process, and importantly not pushy which many of the others were.  The need to be pushy is always a red flag.  The follow through to installation and the installation itself was efficient.  They also called after the installation to check I was happy and helped with questions about the inverter app.  The Sparklife admin team requested for my meter to be updated with my electricity company for my meter, but have not really followed through to ensure it was completed.  The electricity company told me it was the solar company's role and vice versa.  Either way the electricity company should honour the start date for solar. Overall I am happy with the service and product.

Whole experience was professional right from initial quote to final installation. They were Aman was exceptional, fulfilled all our expectations. Customer service could have been better and professional. They Call at odd times without appointment and don't call at appointed time. Took nearly 3 weeks for them to configure.
